pages.title: Tilt Merge
pages.creator: Chorelet
pages.description: Drop numbered blocks into five columns in Tilt Merge. Equal neighbors combine and double, and a single drop can set off several merges. Swipe to tilt every row toward one wall when you need to rearrange the board. Merges refill your limited tilt charges. Chase a personal best in endless mode or try the daily puzzle with 60 drops.

pages.title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Open lucky boxes across 14 areas in Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online. Collect brainrots and decide when to head back with what you've found or keep looking for rarer ones. Upgrade your speed, boxes, and base as you go. Look for an online match in 1 Player mode or share the screen in local two-player mode.

pages.title: Diamondz
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Insert jewels from either side of the board in Diamondz. Match at least three to clear a group and help diamonds fall into the mine carts. The jewel you push out on the opposite side becomes the next one you'll place, so check what your move leaves you.

pages.title: Winter Tetrix Trails
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Fill snowy silhouettes with colorful blocks in Winter Tetrix Trails. Drag each shape into the outline and look for a place where it fits alongside the pieces already down. Leave room for the awkward shapes so you can finish the whole picture.

pages.title: Words or Die
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Spell words from a set of random letters in Words or Die. Each correct word builds the tower under your feet, giving you more height as lava rises. Race other players to come up with words quickly enough to stay above the lava.

pages.title: Table Tennis Open
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Return the ball as it picks up speed in Table Tennis Open. Watch its path and get your racket into place for the next hit. Each successful return earns coins you can spend on racket upgrades while you work on a higher score.

pages.title: Escape From Tung Tung Sahur
pages.creator: Briuor
pages.description: Keep ahead of Tung Tung Sahur in this platform runner. Jump over gaps and watch for obstacles that appear as you cross each level. The layouts change, so use the one-touch controls to time your jumps for the stretch in front of you.

pages.title: Nail Queen
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Run a nail salon and create manicures in Nail Queen. Choose polish colors, then add glitter or gems to make a design for the current challenge. Try different combinations as you work through the salon's fashion levels.

pages.title: Farm of Words
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Link the letters on the circular board in Farm of Words. When you find a word that fits the puzzle, it grows in one of the farm plots above. Keep trying different letter orders until you've filled the open spaces.

pages.title: The Drag Racing Challenge
pages.creator: Wolves Interactive
pages.description: Take on drag racing missions across five cities in The Drag Racing Challenge. Time your gear changes as you race, using E to shift up and Q to shift down. Unlock more than a dozen cars, then customize and upgrade your ride for the next event.

pages.title: Soo Match: Room Design
pages.creator: Anterox Games
pages.description: Tap groups of matching blocks in Soo Match: Room Design. Clear the board's goals to earn tickets, then use them to finish rooms and open up more stages. Spend coins on new characters as you work through the puzzles.

pages.title: Sort: My Parking Area
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Free your car from a crowded lot in Sort: My Parking Area. Look at which vehicles block the exit and move them in an order that gives each one room to get out. Pay attention to tight spaces and obstacles before sending the next car through.

pages.title: Gross Out Run
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Race two computer-controlled runners in Gross Out Run. Watch the sledgehammers as you approach and slip through when they leave an opening. A hit slows you down and stains your clothes. Get to the finish ahead of both runners to win.

pages.title: Stellar Fusion
pages.creator: Back to the Game
pages.description: Clear groups of three or more matching tiles in Stellar Fusion. You can remove a smaller group, but it costs a life. Gather stellar energy quickly in Action Mode, or choose Puzzle Mode and work out how to clear every tile from the board.

pages.title: Draw To Home 3D
pages.creator: Depfov
pages.description: Draw a path from each person to the house of the same color in Draw To Home 3D. Watch for traps and obstacles that cut across a direct route. Trace a safer way around them so everyone can reach the right door.

pages.title: Hand Over Hand
pages.creator: Cubehole
pages.description: Climb to the red flag in Hand Over Hand. Work with the climber's ragdoll movement as you reach for the next hold. Watch for slippery surfaces and moving obstacles, and plan where to grab before you let go of your current hold.

pages.title: Backrooms Among Impostor & Rolling Giant
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Find all the phones before time runs out in Backrooms Among Impostor & Rolling Giant. Watch for the Impostor and the Rolling Giant as you search, and be ready for Granny to turn up. Gather what you need to call a friend for help escaping.

pages.title: Donut Box
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Slide doughnuts and cupcakes into their places in Donut Box. Check the numbers and empty spaces in the box before choosing what to move. Each level starts with a different arrangement, so work out which sweets you can send into place first.

pages.title: Cute Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Put scattered pieces back together in Cute Puzzles. Work from the shapes and picture details, and keep an eye on the timer as you build the image. Choose between two modes, each with 24 levels to complete.

pages.title: Super Simple Soccer
pages.creator: Softlitude
pages.description: Outscore the opposing team in a 90-second match in Super Simple Soccer. Move with the arrows and press C to shoot when you have an opening. Claim the World Cup by winning five consecutive matches.

pages.title: Cargo Ship
pages.creator: GameOn Production KZ
pages.description: Captain a trading vessel in Cargo Ship. Travel along the American coast to buy and sell cargo, then look for hidden areas and artifacts as you explore. Keep trading or take a detour to search for Poseidon's trident.

pages.title: Arena Angry Cars
pages.description: Push rival cars off an arena suspended in the sky in Arena Angry Cars. Watch where the other drivers approach and try to hit them without being shoved over the edge yourself. Stay on the platform as you face eight opponents.

pages.title: Draw
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Study the sample lines in Draw, then reproduce them from memory. Compare how close your drawing came to the original. A score of at least 70 clears the stage and earns a star, which you can put toward a new line color.

pages.title: 3 PIECES GAME
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Find three objects that belong together in 3 PIECES GAME. Look at what the pictures have in common and put the related pieces together to finish the set. Each group gives you a different relationship to work out.

pages.title: Cheat Death
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Fit the available blocks into the marked area in Cheat Death. Check the shape of the gap and decide how the pieces can fill it. Complete the layout so the man can get to the elixir that grants immortality.

pages.title: Milk For Cat
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Cut a rope to feed a cat in Milk For Cat. Watch the bag of milk swing like a pendulum and wait until it's over the cat before releasing it. A well-timed drop feeds the cat and earns points.

pages.title: Just a game
pages.creator: Gold Skull Studios
pages.description: Rotate the level to guide a ball to the exit in Just a game. Watch where the ball rolls as the room turns, then change the angle to get around the next corner. The layouts get harder as you advance.

pages.title: Ball Collector
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Send colored balls into their matching targets in Ball Collector. Watch the bomb move across the yellow, pink, and blue targets. Click a target when the path is clear, because the run ends if the bomb hits the balls.

pages.title: Kingdom of Ninja 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Reach the chest to move on in Kingdom of Ninja 2. Guide the ninja around obstacles and keep clear of monsters as you cross each stage. There are ten levels, each with its own route to the next chest.

pages.title: Archer Peerless
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Aim with the mouse and click to fire in Archer Peerless. Check where your shot lands and adjust your aim as you line up the next arrow. Play on your own or switch to battle mode for a different archery challenge.

pages.title: Dress Up High School Prom Queen
pages.creator: DESIGN GAMES INC
pages.description: Get a nervous student ready for the school dance in Dress Up High School Prom Queen. Style her hair and choose makeup, then put together an outfit for prom. Try different looks in the salon before sending her to the dance.

pages.title: Among Hill Climber
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Drive across fourteen hilly courses in Among Hill Climber. Pick a vehicle such as a bike, a truck, a taxi, or a tank and see how it handles the terrain. Look for gold and fuel cans as you climb and descend.

pages.title: Shaun The Sheep Alien Athletics
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help Shaun escape the aliens in Shaun The Sheep Alien Athletics. Jump over obstacles as he runs and watch the ground ahead so you can time the next leap. A fall gives the aliens a chance to catch him.

pages.title: Winter Jewels Saga
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Swap winter-themed jewels in Winter Jewels Saga to make rows or columns of three or more. Line up at least four to create a power-up, then use it to help clear the board. Work through the different objectives across 80 levels.

pages.title: Time of Adventure Finn
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Explore the snow lands in Time of Adventure Finn. Keep out of the Snow King's soldiers' way while you look for crystals, then find a route to the end of the stage. The adventure takes you through eleven chapters.

pages.title: Robbers in the House
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Stop a gang from stealing a royal crown in Robbers in the House. The robbers are holed up in the central museum, so watch for them to show themselves and take your shots when you have a clear target. Keep looking for the next robber before they get away.

pages.title: Maze Twist
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Turn the maze itself to move the ball in Maze Twist. Look at the geometric corridors and rotate the layout so the ball rolls into the passage you need. Guide it around the bends until you reach the way out.

pages.title: School Bus Differences
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Compare two school bus pictures in School Bus Differences. Tap the parts of the scene that have changed and keep looking until you've found all seven differences. Use the time you have to check details around the bus as well as the bus itself.

pages.title: Painting Vintage Cars Jigsaw Puzzle 2
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Assemble painted scenes of vintage cars in Painting Vintage Cars Jigsaw Puzzle 2. Pick one of eight images and choose a 2-by-3, 3-by-4, or 4-by-6 layout. Look at the car's painted details to work out where each piece fits.

pages.title: Kitty Lunchbox
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Make lunch with Hello Kitty in Kitty Lunchbox. Choose a recipe in the school cafeteria and prepare it the way she asks. Completing the recipe earns decorations you can use to give the lunchbox your own look.

pages.title: Public Transport Vehicles Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Compare two pictures of public transport in Public Transport Vehicles Difference. Look closely at details on buses, trains, and the scenes around them, then mark the spots that don't match. Keep scanning both pictures as the timer runs down.

pages.title: Valentine Mix Match
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Turn over cards to reveal Valentine's Day pictures in Valentine Mix Match. Remember where each image appeared so you can find it again when its partner turns up. Keep making pairs until you've cleared the board.

pages.title: Basket Bird
pages.creator: Mabno
pages.description: Tap to guide a bird into a basket-shaped cloud in Basket Bird. Watch the bird's height and judge when to tap again as you approach the cloud. The time allowance gets shorter, so try to make each trip to the basket quicker.

pages.title: Military Transport Vehicle
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive a military vehicle through checkpoint routes in Military Transport Vehicle. Use WASD to steer and control your speed as you head toward each destination. Keep an eye on the next checkpoint and work through the different levels.

pages.title: Space Shooter Alien
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Guide a spacecraft through enemy fire in Space Shooter Alien. Move the ship while its guns fire automatically, and pick up ammunition, rockets, and fuel to keep going. Look for jewels and upgrades as you try to stay in the fight and raise your score.

pages.title: Winter Time Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Look for five changes between the pictures in Winter Time Difference. Compare the matching parts of each winter scene and select the details that differ. There's no timer, so you can study the pictures until you've found enough differences to move on.

pages.title: Fruit Farm Frenzy
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Gather the fruit shown in each level's goal in Fruit Farm Frenzy. Look for matching fruit on the board and clear groups that count toward the harvest. Keep checking what you still need as the matches change the layout.

pages.title: 4x4 Offroad Monster Truck
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Take a four-wheel drive, monster truck, or six-wheeled vehicle across off-road trials in 4x4 Offroad Monster Truck. Judge the approach to each barrier and see how the vehicle handles on uneven ground. Work your way past the obstacles without losing control.

pages.title: Box VS Triangles
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tap left or right to hit incoming triangles in Box VS Triangles. Watch which side the next triangle is coming from and move the box in time to break it. Pick up bonuses that help you smash more and see how high you can score.

pages.title: Dynamite Drop
pages.creator: Art Of Play Games
pages.description: Shoot the objects supporting the dynamite in Dynamite Drop. Remove blocks, barrels, and cans in an order that lets the charge fall into the water. Keep an eye on the fuse and use as few shots as possible to earn a higher score.

pages.title: Solitaire Classic Games
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a layout in Solitaire Classic Games and move cards with the mouse. Try Klondike, Spider, or FreeCell and work through the stacks under the rules of the game you pick. Switch variants when you want a different kind of card puzzle.

pages.title: Burning Man2
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Get a man who's on fire into the water in Burning Man2. Look at where he starts and work out how to make him fall in. Use the arrangement in each puzzle to put out the flames and save him.

pages.title: Monsters Memory Match
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Flip cards to reveal monsters in Monsters Memory Match. Remember where each picture appeared and look for its partner as you turn over more cards. Clear the board at your own pace, since the game gives you as much time as you need.

pages.title: BTS Emoji Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick colors for an emoji drawing in BTS Emoji Coloring. Use the palette to fill in the design and try different combinations on its details. When you're happy with the picture, download it or print a copy.

pages.title: Sleepy Princess Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Choose a scene from Sleepy Princess Coloring Book and fill it with colors from the palette. Add glitter to finish the drawing, then see how it looks in a frame. Turn to another page when you want a different scene to color.

pages.title: EG Gibbet Archery
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Aim at the ropes in EG Gibbet Archery to free the people hanging from them. Adjust your shot so the arrow crosses the rope safely. Each layout gives you a different angle to work out as you try to get everyone down unharmed.

pages.title: Ketchapp Basketball
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Swipe the basketball toward the hoop in Ketchapp Basketball. Adjust each swipe to get the ball on target and keep scoring. Collect stars to unlock other balls, and try the four modes when you want to compete with friends or other players.

pages.title: Cookie Jam
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Line up three or more identical cookies in Cookie Jam. Look across the rows and columns for a move that brings a matching group together. Each group disappears, changing the layout and giving you a new set of matches to look for.

pages.title: Jump Ninja Hero
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Keep a running ninja clear of flying shuriken in Jump Ninja Hero. Watch how high each blade is coming in and time your jumps to get past it. The ninja keeps running, so look ahead for the next throw as you try to improve your score.

pages.title: Monoa City Parking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive through Monoa City and park before time runs out in Monoa City Parking. Watch for obstacles that can slow you down on the way to the parking spot. Complete the level without hitting any of them to earn a better payout.

pages.title: Stars & Royals BFF Party Night
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Get Selena and Cinderella ready for a night at the club in Stars & Royals BFF Party Night. Pick clothes with sparkle and choose shoes that suit a night of dancing. Put together a look for each friend before their party begins.

pages.title: GTA Quiz
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Identify Grand Theft Auto characters in GTA Quiz. Look at each picture for recognizable details, then choose the name you think matches. Work through the questions and see how many characters you remember.

pages.title: AirWings.io
pages.creator: restinggames.com
pages.description: Outmaneuver homing missiles in AirWings.io. Turn the plane to send missiles into each other and pick up stars for a higher score. A Repair pickup fixes damaged wings, while Shield protects you briefly. Keep flying as long as you can.

pages.title: Plumber Soda
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Connect a soda keg to a bottle in Plumber Soda. Click straw pieces to rotate them until they form an unbroken route. Some pieces won't help, and you have only so many moves, so work out which turns you need before using them.

pages.title: Princess Silver Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Give the princess a silver hairstyle in Princess Silver Hairstyles. Work on the hair in the salon, then pick clothes and accessories to go with the finished style. Try different choices to see how they change the look.

pages.title: Real Piano Online
pages.creator: MTMEDIA SL
pages.description: Play notes with your keyboard in Real Piano Online. Switch octaves to reach higher or lower notes and choose a different piano sound when you want to change how a piece sounds. Try a melody or use the keys to practice a section of a song.

pages.title: TriPeaks Solitaire
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Clear the three peaks in TriPeaks Solitaire. Pick an available card one rank above or below the current card, then look for a move that uncovers more of the layout. Draw from the deck if you can't make another move.

pages.title: Zombie Dungeon Challenge
pages.creator: WI Games
pages.description: Hold your position against the undead in Zombie Dungeon Challenge. Shoot the zombies coming toward you and watch for the next target as the dungeon fills up. See how many you can take down before you're overwhelmed.

pages.title: Desert Racer
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Drive across desert courses in Desert Racer. Use the arrow keys or on-screen controls to manage the car as you climb and descend. Watch how it lands after a rise, and get it to the finish to move on to the next level.

pages.title: Barbie Paper Bag Pants
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Build an outfit around paper-bag-waist trousers in Barbie Paper Bag Pants. Choose a pair from Barbie's spring wardrobe, then find a top and accessories to go with it. Try another combination to see how different pieces change the look.

pages.title: Super Hero Cooking Contest!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pick a superhero and help her bake a cake in Super Hero Cooking Contest! Work through the recipe and prepare the dessert for the competition. Each cooking step brings your hero closer to having a cake ready to present.

pages.title: Euro Penalty 2016
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Take part in football penalty shootouts in Euro Penalty 2016. Aim your kick and try to put it past the goalkeeper. Pay attention to which shots get through and adjust your next attempt as you work to outscore the opposition.

pages.title: Ice Queen Surprise Birthday Party
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Plan Elsa's birthday in Ice Queen Surprise Birthday Party. Pick her makeup and outfit, bake a cake, and set the table for her guests. Once the preparations are done, join the party to blow out the candles and open presents.

pages.title: Ice Queen Driver License Test
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Help Elsa pass the written test in Ice Queen Driver License Test. Read the questions and use what you know about traffic signs to choose your answers. Get at least seven of the ten questions right to pass.

pages.title: Mall Shopping Spree
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Style three friends for a trip to the shops in Mall Shopping Spree. Choose clothes and accessories for each friend and see how different colors work together. Give all three their own outfits before they go shopping.

pages.title: Fruit Break
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Slice fruit as it appears in Fruit Break. Keep the blade away from bombs while trying to hit as many pieces of fruit as you can. You have 60 seconds to build your score, so watch for groups you can cut in one swipe.
